title: Design and preclinical characterization of an affinity-tuned BCMA×CD3 bispecific T-cell engager for broad B-cell depletion.
snippet: B cell maturation antigen (BCMA) is a validated target for plasma cell depletion; however, T cell-redirecting approaches must balance potent cytotoxicity with controlled T cell activation.
